description: This file contains test utilities and mock socket classes for testing transport client socket pools in the Chromium net codebase, including mock implementations of various socket behaviors and functions to verify load timing info.

classes.name: MockConnectClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket that connects synchronously and successfully.

classes.name: MockFailingClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket that fails to connect with a specified error.

classes.name: MockTriggerableClientSocket
classes.description: A mock socket that can delay or stall connection attempts, allowing tests to trigger connection callbacks manually.

classes.name: MockTransportClientSocketFactory::Rule
classes.description: Defines rules for creating different types of mock sockets during tests.

methods.name: ParseIP
methods.description: Parses a string IP literal into an IPAddress object.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedReused
methods.description: Verifies load timing info for a reused socket handle.

methods.name: TestLoadTimingInfoConnectedNotReused
methods.description: Verifies load timing info for a non-reused socket handle.

methods.name: SetIPv4Address
methods.description: Sets an IPEndPoint to a specific IPv4 address.

methods.name: SetIPv6Address
methods.description: Sets an IPEndPoint to a specific IPv6 address.
